% Checks cases that a fix of references to appendix chapters must not
% break: an appendix made by hand, with the chapter counter reset and
% lettered, without \appendix.
\documentclass{report}
\begin{document}
\chapter{Main}\label{main}
Ref: \ref{app:a}; \ref{app:b}; \ref{sec:a}; \ref{main}.
\setcounter{chapter}{0}
\renewcommand\thechapter{\Alph{chapter}}
\chapter{Extra}\label{app:a}
\section{More}\label{sec:a}
Text of the section.
\chapter{Second extra}\label{app:b}
Text of the second appendix.
\end{document}
